name: Weddings
title: Wedding Lawn Games Hire | Pretoria & Johannesburg
description: Hire giant lawn games for your wedding in Pretoria, Johannesburg or Gauteng. Keep guests entertained between ceremony and reception with croquet or boules.
lead: The gap between the ceremony and the reception is the part of a wedding most couples forget to plan. Guests have a drink in hand, the photographs are happening somewhere else, and forty minutes need filling. A few lawn games on the grass solve it completely - and they photograph beautifully.
sections: Which games work at a wedding

The games that suit a wedding are the ones guests can play in formal clothes, at a gentle pace, with a glass in the other hand. Croquet is the obvious one - it's practically made for a lawn in the afternoon light. Boules is sociable and slow. Giant 4 in a Row and High Tower draw a crowd of onlookers, which is what you want near the bar. Avoid anything that involves running.
How many games for your guest count

As a rule of thumb, one game keeps six to eight people occupied. For a wedding of 80 to 120 guests, four to six games spread across the lawn means there's always something free to play, without it looking like a fairground. Our Option 1 and Option 2 packages - two Big, two Medium and one or two Small games - are sized for exactly this.
Timing and setup

Games work best during the drinks reception and again after the meal, before the dancing. We deliver the day before your wedding, so your venue or coordinator can set the games out in the morning without any pressure on the day, and we collect the day after. Every package includes a custom WhatsApp invitation designed to match your theme, at no extra cost.
Venues and lawns

We deliver to wedding venues across Pretoria, Johannesburg, Centurion, Midrand and the surrounding areas. Croquet needs a decent stretch of short lawn; most of the other games are happy on a smaller patch of grass or even the paved terrace. If you send us a photo of the venue's outdoor space, we'll tell you what fits.
faqs: Do you set the games up at the venue?

The games are delivered the day before with everything needed to set them up, and each comes with simple instructions. Most venues and coordinators handle it in a few minutes; ask us if you'd like to discuss on-site setup.
Will the games survive a formal crowd?
They're built for it. Croquet, boules and quoits are unhurried and can be played in a suit or a dress; nothing requires running or getting on the ground.
Can guests play in the evening?
Yes, as long as the area is lit. Giant 4 in a Row and High Tower work particularly well under festoon lights after dinner.

name: Corporate & team building
title: Team Building & Corporate Games Hire | Pretoria & Joburg
h1: Lawn games for corporate events and team building
description: Hire giant lawn games for team building days, corporate functions and year-end events across Pretoria, Johannesburg and Gauteng.
lead: The best team-building activities are the ones people don't have to be talked into. Put giant lawn games on the grass at a year-end function, a staff braai or an offsite, and colleagues who've never spoken end up on the same croquet team arguing about the rules. No facilitator, no icebreaker script.
sections: Games that get a team talking

For groups, choose games with teams and a bit of competition. Cornhole and boules both play in pairs and have enough strategy to argue about. High Tower is the one that gets a whole department gathered round watching. Giant 4 in a Row runs as a quick knockout tournament - a bracket on a whiteboard turns it into an hour's entertainment.
Running a tournament

A simple format that works: pick four games, split the group into teams of four, and rotate every fifteen minutes so each team plays every game. Keep a running score on a board. It takes an hour, needs no equipment beyond the games, and gives the quiet people a reason to get involved. Our Option 1 package - six games - covers a group of 40 to 60 comfortably.
Office, venue or offsite

We deliver to offices, conference venues, game lodges and private venues across Pretoria, Johannesburg and Gauteng. Most of the games work on paving and decking as well as grass, so a car park or rooftop terrace is fine. Equipment is delivered the day before and collected the day after, so there's no time pressure on the day itself.
Invoicing

We can invoice your company directly. A copy of the responsible person's ID and a signed indemnity form are required before the equipment is released, and the deposit is refunded to your account after the games are returned in good condition.
faqs: How many people can the games keep busy?
Plan on six to eight people per game. Six games - our largest package - comfortably occupies 40 to 60 people in rotation, more if they're playing in a tournament format.
Do the games need grass?
Not most of them. Giant 4 in a Row, High Tower, cornhole, quoits and dominoes all work on paving, decking or an indoor floor. Croquet and lawn darts need grass.
Can you invoice the company?
Yes. Let us know the details when you enquire and we'll send a formal invoice.

name: Birthdays & garden parties
title: Birthday Party Lawn Games Hire | Pretoria & Johannesburg
h1: Lawn games for birthdays and garden parties
description: Hire giant lawn games for a milestone birthday, kids' party or garden celebration in Pretoria, Johannesburg or Gauteng. Games for every age from three up.
lead: A birthday on the lawn with a few oversized games is the party that guests of every age actually enjoy - grandparents playing dominoes, toddlers on noughts and crosses, and the adults getting far too competitive at cornhole. It's also the easiest kind of party to host: the games do the entertaining.
sections: For children's parties

The games that work for younger children are the ones with no waiting and nothing to explain. Giant noughts and crosses suits ages three and up. Quoits is an instant favourite from about four, and Giant 4 in a Row joins the list if you lay the board flat on the lawn so small arms can reach the top row. Giant dominoes get used as much for toppling runs as for the actual game. Skip horseshoes and lawn darts for the under-eights.
For milestone birthdays

A 40th, 50th or 60th on the lawn suits the slower, more sociable games - boules, croquet, and High Tower for the moment everyone gathers round. Our Option 3 package - one Big, two Medium and two Small games - is a good fit for a garden party of 30 to 50 people, and includes a custom WhatsApp invitation to send out.
Space and surfaces

You don't need a large garden. Most of the games fit in a few square metres, and several work on the patio if the lawn is small. Croquet is the only one that really wants a proper stretch of grass. If you're not sure what fits, send us a photo of the space.
Delivery and collection

We deliver across Pretoria, Johannesburg, Centurion, Midrand and surrounding areas the day before your party and collect the day after, so you're not waiting on a delivery on the morning of the event. Delivery is R200 in Pretoria and R300 in Johannesburg, or free when you collect the games yourself.
faqs: What age are the games suitable for?

From three upwards. Noughts and crosses and quoits suit the youngest children; Giant 4 in a Row works for small children if the board is laid flat on the ground rather than stood on its legs; horseshoes and lawn darts are better for eight and older. Every game page lists a recommended age.
Do I need a big garden?
No. Apart from croquet, each game needs only a few square metres, and several can go on paving if the lawn is small.
Can I hire just one game?
Yes. Every game is available on its own from R150, or bundled in a package at a lower combined price.

name: Bachelor & bachelorette parties
title: Bachelorette & Bachelor Party Games Hire | Gauteng
h1: Lawn games for bachelorette, bachelor and kitchen tea parties
description: Hire giant lawn games for a bachelorette, kitchen tea, stag or bachelor party in Pretoria or Johannesburg. Sociable, photo-friendly games for a garden day.
lead: A bachelorette picnic, a kitchen tea on the lawn, a stag braai - the daytime version of the send-off works best when there's something to do besides talk. A few giant games on the grass give the group a focus, get the quieter friends involved, and produce the photos everyone actually wants from the day.
sections: Games that suit a hen or bachelorette day

The winners here are the ones that photograph well and get a crowd cheering. High Tower - our giant Jenga - is the centrepiece: the moment it falls is the picture of the day. Giant 4 in a Row runs as a quick knockout between friends. Boules and quoits are easy with a glass in hand. For a kitchen tea with mixed ages, giant dominoes and noughts and crosses keep everyone from grandmothers to flower girls playing.
Games that suit a stag or bachelor braai

Go for the competitive ones. Cornhole and horseshoe throwing both have a knack that rewards practice and invites a wager. High Tower gets more nerve-wracking as the afternoon goes on. A simple bracket on a whiteboard turns three games into a tournament that fills the gap between the braai lighting and the meat being ready.
How many games for the group

Most send-offs are 10 to 20 people, which is comfortably covered by two or three games. Our Option 4 package - one Big, one Medium and one Small game - is sized for exactly this and includes a custom WhatsApp invitation to send round the group. For a bigger crowd or a full-day event, Option 3 adds two more.
Where and when

The games work in a back garden, at a picnic spot or at an Airbnb with a lawn, and most of them are fine on a patio if the grass is small. We deliver across Pretoria, Johannesburg, Centurion, Midrand and surrounding areas the day before and collect the day after, so the organiser isn't waiting on a delivery on the morning. Everything packs into carry bags and cases, so it also travels to a venue in the boot of a car.
faqs: Which games work best for a bachelorette or kitchen tea?
High Tower for the photos, Giant 4 in a Row for a quick tournament, and boules or quoits for anyone who'd rather play with a drink in hand. For a kitchen tea with older relatives, add giant dominoes.
Can we take the games to a picnic spot or Airbnb?
Yes. Every game packs into a carry bag or case that fits in a car. The one thing to check is that the venue has a patch of flat lawn or paving.
Is there a smaller package for a group of ten?
Option 4 - one Big, one Medium and one Small game at R800 - is the usual choice for 10 to 20 people. You can also hire any single game from R150.
